title: Naval units in the Human look: crimson-and-gold sails with a gold cross on the pale polished hulls (cog, carrack, rowing barge) and their portraits

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the colours of the sail and pennant: the big red sail becomes deep crimson cloth, colour #a8202c with #6e1018 shadows, with a thin gold-yellow border and one big gold-yellow cross in its middle; the red pennant becomes crimson with a gold-yellow tip; add a thin gold-yellow trim along the top rail. Keep the pale wooden hull, mast, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The accepted batch-4 Patrol Boat (a single-mast cog) with the Human crimson and gold on the sail.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the colours of the sails and pennants: both big red sails become deep crimson cloth, colour #a8202c with #6e1018 shadows, each with a thin gold-yellow border and one big gold-yellow cross in its middle; the red pennants become crimson with gold-yellow tips. Keep the pale wooden hull, the grey stone tower and rails, ship shape, size, the empty space at the left and right edges, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The accepted batch-4 Battleship (a two-mast carrack) with the Human crimson and gold on the sails.

recipes.editInstruction: Change only the colours of the tarp and pennant: the big red tarp over the cargo becomes deep crimson canvas, colour #a8202c with #6e1018 shadows, with a thin gold-yellow border and one big gold-yellow cross on top; the red pennant becomes crimson with a gold-yellow tip. Keep the pale wooden hull, oars, ropes, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
recipes.notes: The accepted batch-4 rowing barge with the Human crimson and gold on the tarp.
